answer: An agent economy can require each new identity to earn a nontransferable reputation through jobs whose results are checked by randomly assigned, established peers. A sybil farm must then do useful work and risk rejection across many identities; creating accounts alone earns no standing. To make collusion costly, peers stake deposits that are slashed when audits expose fabricated results. The ferrous workshop, comet courier, and orchard keeper can all join, but none can buy instant trust.
